material_novelty: Combines an outer-tail opening dislocation, explicit continuation failure at the causally known opening extreme, retest without valid extension, reclaim of one pre-frozen structural reference, and a later completed-candle hold before next-bar entry. Prior nearest mechanisms covered repair/second-side acceptance, prior-body midpoint rejection, ORB retest/reclaim, VWAP migration, or cross-index reversal separately, not this exact causal sequence.
